section: Deadlines and filing / Foreign crypto custody:2026 balances and the2027 procedure
guide_wording: | Gipuzkoa | Actual current DF47/2013 **54bis**, amendment note118: DF26/2025 applies from **1January2026**. It supplies the corresponding MiCA/Spain authorisation/notification/register conditions and **1January–30June** regulatory window. The actual current body controls despite its older-looking PDF URL. | Existing OF571/2023 art.4 says **1April–30June**. The current public721 page also retains an annual EUR50,000 later-year wording and older foreign-custodian explanation, which differ from actual current54bis. Follow54bis for the substantive gate; keep the narrower model window and applicable2027 procedure separately unresolved. [Current54bis/effect note118](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/null/DF%2047-2013%20%282024-1%29.pdf/550c41c4-559d-808c-e123-b14fed696801), [OF571/2023 arts.3–5](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/62711141/OF%20571-2023.pdf/1139fb71-fe01-3a52-6169-e4fa8568fd67?t=1703674947346), [older-worded public721 page](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/es/web/ogasuna/impuestos/modelo/721) |
provision: Official act identified by URL article 54bis
quote: modifican determinados reglamentos de desarrollo de la Norma Foral General Tributaria (BOG 8/10/2021). El Decreto Foral entra en vigor el día siguiente al de su publicación en el Boletín Oficial de Gipuzkoa y la modificación surte efectos a partir de 1 de enero de 2022.
